uutiset.t: Dollar Heads for Fourth Week of Gains Following Anthropic IPO
uutiset.s: The dollar is headed for a fourth straight weekly gain as demand tied to the Anthropic PBC IPO further lifts the currency that has been supported by expectations of further Federal Reserve interest-rate hikes and elevated US Treasury yields.

uutiset.t: India’s Stock Rally Faces Valuation Test as Bond Allure Grows
uutiset.s: India’s stock rebound is approaching a crucial valuation test as rising bond yields make sovereign debt an increasingly viable alternative to equities.

uutiset.t: Gold Set for Worst Week Since March on Hawkish Fed
uutiset.s: Gold fell and was heading for the biggest weekly decline since March, as a hawkish Federal Reserve signaled more interest-rate hikes and a selloff in AI stocks pushed investors to sell the metal to cover losses.

uutiset.t: Anthropic IPO Raises Only $110 Million From Australian Investors
uutiset.s: Australian investors were allocated less than 1% of total shares from Anthropic PBC’s record-breaking initial public offering.

uutiset.t: Anthropic Becomes World’s 7th Most Valuable Company After IPO
uutiset.s: Anthropic PBC’s blockbuster IPO lifted the company into the ranks of the most valuable in the world, with shares closing 17% from the offer price to give it a $1.8 trillion fully diluted market value.

uutiset.t: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Nov. 20
uutiset.s: Oil edged higher after a volatile session on Thursday, with futures on track for a third weekly decline as traders weigh the risk of renewed US strikes on Iran against ample supply.

uutiset.t: Treasury Official Renews Warning on Wave of Tax-Saving Trades
uutiset.s: A senior US Treasury official reiterated concerns Thursday about Wall Street’s tax-efficient investing boom, saying firms should win clients on the merits of their investments, not on how far they’ll go to minimize a tax bill.

uutiset.t: Anthropic IPO is About Capital, Says Kathryn Thompson
uutiset.s: Anthropic’s long-awaited debut marks the first ever by a frontier AI lab, a cohort of firms building the most advanced models to tackle difficult problems and assist users in complex tasks. uutiset.t: Asian Stocks Fall, Anthropic Slips in After-Hours: Markets Wrap
uutiset.s: Asian stocks sold off as pessimism over the artificial-intelligence trade hammered technology shares, with global equities set for their longest losing streak in three years. Anthropic PBC fell in after-hours trading after jumping on its market debut.

uutiset.t: NY’s Largest Mall Debt Now Controlled by Billionaire Namdar
uutiset.s: The debt on Destiny USA, New York state’s largest shopping center, has been acquired by Namdar Realty Group, a Long Island-based real estate firm known for distressed retail real estate deals.

uutiset.t: Shenkman, Blackstone, GDA Among Lenders to Take Over Vivid
uutiset.s: A group of lenders including Blackstone Inc. and Shenkman Capital Management are set to take over Vivid Seats Inc. in a deal that would reduce the ticket reseller’s net debt by more than $200 million, according to people familiar with the matter.

uutiset.t: Fed Tells Regional Staff to Expect Lower Pay Hikes in 2027
uutiset.s: The Federal Reserve has warned employees at its regional outposts to expect lower pay increases next year, according to a memo viewed by Bloomberg News.

uutiset.t: Nintendo Gains as ‘Roaring Kitty’ Posts Mario Character on X
uutiset.s: Nintendo Co.’s American depositary receipts soared Thursday after an account associated with Keith Gill, the online persona known as “Roaring Kitty,” posted an image of the firm’s mascot on X.

uutiset.t: Alphabet Raises $4.2 Billion From Latest Canada Bond Sale
uutiset.s: Alphabet Inc. sold C$6 billion ($4.2 billion) of Canadian bonds, six months after its market debut.

uutiset.t: Mexican Peso Rout Deepens as Banxico, Fed Policies Diverge
uutiset.s: The Mexican peso sank past the 19-per-dollar mark to its lowest in over a year, as the prospect of further Federal Reserve interest-rate hikes intensified a selloff triggered by Mexico’s dovish monetary policy.
